findings.title: Upload panel CSS references undefined theme tokens --text and --text-muted
findings.suggested_fix: tokens.css (tethysapp/ngiab/public/frontend/styles/tokens.css) only defines --fg, --fg-muted, --fg-subtle for text colour -- there is no --text or --text-muted token anywhere in the codebase, confirmed by grep and by every other rule in map.html (e.g. line 164 '.candidate-note { color: var(--fg-subtle); }', line 198 '#map-search-empty { ... color: var(--fg-muted); }'). The new rules '#upload-panel summary { ...color: var(--text-muted); }' (line 122) and '#upload-panel summary:hover { color: var(--text); }' (line 123) use token names that do not exist, so both properties resolve to the CSS-wide keyword 'unset' and the summary text falls back to the browser default colour in both themes -- it will not follow dark mode the way every sibling rule in this file does. scripts/check-theme-tokens.py and scripts/check-contrast.py both pass because neither script checks that a var(--x) reference in map.html resolves to a token actually declared in tokens.css; they only compare tokens.css's own two dark blocks and the declared tokens' contrast ratios. Replace --text-muted with --fg-muted and --text with --fg to match the token names used by every other rule in this file.

findings.title: README hosted-deployment docs omit the S3 env vars the shipped hook script actually reads
findings.suggested_fix: The new '##### Hosted deployments' section (README.md line 97-104) says: 'Set `NGIAB_STORAGE_BACKEND=s3` and configure a `ngiab_runs` entry in Django's `STORAGES` setting'. That does not match what this branch actually ships: conf/portal-config.d/20-object-storage.sh (also new in this diff) auto-configures STORAGES from NGIAB_STORAGE_BACKEND, NGIAB_S3_BUCKET, NGIAB_S3_ENDPOINT and NGIAB_RUNS_PREFIX, and it writes the bucket under the `default` STORAGES key (see 20-object-storage.sh line 55: `{"default": {"BACKEND": "storages.backends.s3.S3Storage", ...}}`), not a key named `ngiab_runs`. NGIAB_S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT (read by tethysapp/ngiab/controllers.py line 347 for presigned-URL rewriting) is not mentioned in README.md at all. An operator following the documented instructions literally -- hand-configuring a `ngiab_runs` STORAGES entry -- will not reproduce what the shipped portal-config hook does, and will not know NGIAB_S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT exists for the common case where the bucket's internal and externally-reachable endpoints differ (which scripts/try-object-storage.sh, also new, explicitly exercises). Document the five env vars the code reads (NGIAB_STORAGE_BACKEND, NGIAB_S3_BUCKET, NGIAB_S3_ENDPOINT, NGIAB_S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT, NGIAB_RUNS_PREFIX) and correct the STORAGES key name from `ngiab_runs` to `default`.

findings.title: New upload component and lib module are not added to the frontend README's Layout table
findings.suggested_fix: The Layout table in tethysapp/ngiab/public/frontend/README.md (lines 15-38) enumerates every file in public/frontend/ with its responsibility, immediately followed by the statement that 'lib/ and layers.js modules take explicit arguments... which is what makes them unit-testable' -- the table is presented as the authoritative map of the directory. This diff adds tethysapp/ngiab/public/frontend/components/ngiab-upload-run.js and tethysapp/ngiab/public/frontend/lib/upload.js, neither of which appears in the table (the last components row, line 36, is still 'ngiab-model-runs.js | Model-run selector.'). Add a row for each new file so the table continues to describe the actual directory contents.
